description: I'm Hareesh, team lead of "Galaxy Warriors," and we are excited to participate in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Virudhunagar Local Event! Our team has chosen the critical challenge: "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions." As humanity pushes further into deep space, ensuring the physical and mental well-being of our astronauts becomes one of the most vital hurdles to overcome.
summary:
Our project, ASTRA, is an AI and IoT-based Astronaut Health Monitoring System designed for space missions.

It collects astronaut health information through wearable sensors and displays vital signs such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, body temperature and activity levels.

Using Artificial Intelligence, the system analyses health trends and identifies unusual patterns that may require medical attention.

A smart dashboard provides real-time health visualisation, digital medical records and automatic alerts.

Our ultimate goal is to support astronaut safety and improve healthcare monitoring during long-duration space exploration.

ASTRA – Monitor. Predict. Protect.
